component.name: Boreal Bounce
component.summary: Match falling bubbles before they reach the bottom

description.p: Boreal Bounce is a bubble puzzle game: aim the launcher, fire a bubble, and clear the board by grouping three or more of a colour before the ceiling presses down on you.

It is a Godot 4 rewrite of Frozen-Bubble, reusing that game's artwork, music, levels and translations. It offers a hundred levels, random levels, a two minute training mode, two players at one keyboard, network play over a local network or the internet, replays and a level editor.
